answer.summary: The mistake is granting an agent both read and write permissions for a combined task; CAMEL may not stop prompt injection when those permissions are both necessary to the task.

sections.heading: Permission-design mistake
sections.content: If a request combines reading email with forwarding selected messages—for example, reading recent emails and forwarding ops requests—the system may grant the agent both read and send permissions. A malicious email can then prompt an unintended action, and CAMEL cannot block it using permission separation because both capabilities were authorized. Schulhoff contrasts this with a summary-only request, where read-only access prevents an injected instruction to send email.
